svg.desc: Pull request checks: 4 nodes, 3 connections. 2 jobs and their steps of the check workflow, started by a pull request or a push to main, in the order their needs set, imported from GitHub Actions. Nodes: - Pull request or push, terminal - CI and CD: Generated diagrams match their files (Calls plotwork-check.yml) - Generated diagrams match their files (Calls plotwork-check.yml), step - CI and CD: Hand-written diagrams are valid and drawn (ubuntu-latest) - Checkout, step - Plotwork official plotwork, step Connections: - Pull request or push to Generated diagrams match their files - Pull request or push to Checkout - Checkout to Plotwork official plotwork
